questions.text: Describe how AEM Assets would tie an approved discharge leaflet to its specialty, reading level and review date.
Show how AEM Assets would prevent ward staff from choosing a withdrawn translation after the English master has changed.
Explain how AEM Assets would let our nursing reviewers trace who approved a revised leaflet and retrieve the version it replaced.
Provide an AEM Assets pilot test for a scanned leaflet supplied without a language tag or named clinical owner.
Describe the AEM Sites publishing roles for a shared leaflet page used by adult and pediatric wards.
Explain how AEM Sites and Akamai would handle an urgent leaflet withdrawal during the night shift.
Show how AEM Sites would preserve printed ward QR codes when the communications team changes a document's display title.
Provide evidence that AEM Sites delivers the mobile leaflet page in the approved language after a ward kiosk switches locale.
Identify the supplier's clinical content training lead and confirm the person's availability for evening classes.
Provide references from two hospital teams that have trained rotating nurses to use a shared publication process.
State your firm's fees for training additional hospitals after the pilot wards accept the library.
Describe your company's process for transferring the training materials and attendance records to our education coordinator.
